en: Black-and-white postcard view of a harbor with several steamships and boats moored in the foreground. Behind the waterfront warehouses and low buildings rise a few early high‑rise structures, one being a prominent rectangular tower. The scene shows an urban waterfront area with industrial and commercial buildings. Swedish text is printed along the bottom edge, and a small triangular publisher's mark with the year 1919 appears in the lower right corner.
